value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or V; m/u/µ/μ prefixes, for example 500 mV or 1 V

limitations: Ideal DC voltage source; positive minus negative sets its voltage, and either terminal may be above/below ground in a referenced network. No output resistance, current limit, battery discharge, noise, heating, ratings or physical part identity.
name: DC source

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or Ω/ohm; k/K/M prefixes, for example 2.2k or 0.1M Ω

limitations: Ideal constant resistance; no tolerance, heating, parasitics, ratings or physical part identity. Current is positive from pin 1 to pin 2.
name: Resistor

limitations: Educational generic diode; no physical part identity, reverse breakdown, thermal dynamics, ratings, or calibrated brightness.
name: Red LED

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or F; p/n/u/µ/μ/m prefixes, for example 1 µF or 100nF

limitations: Ideal capacitor with configurable initial voltage; no ESR, leakage, polarity, heating, ratings or physical part identity. Voltage and current use pin 1 relative to pin 2.
name: Capacitor

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or H; n/u/µ/μ/m prefixes, for example 10 mH or 100uH

limitations: Ideal constant inductance with configurable signed initial current; voltage pin 1 minus pin 2, current into pin 1/out of pin 2, energy L I² / 2. No winding resistance, saturation, mutual coupling, parasitic capacitance, heating, ratings or physical part identity. Add external resistance and a return path for switching current.
name: Inductor

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or V; m/u/µ/μ prefixes, for example 500 mV or 1 V
value_domain.relation: Amplitude plus the absolute offset must be ≤12 V.

limitations: Ideal grounded voltage sources with per-component periodic sine or linear pulse ramps. No output resistance, current limit, battery discharge, noise or physical generator identity. Finite pulse high/low phase lengths include rise/fall respectively. Output sampling can alias; internal integration resolves waveform features within its work budget.
name: Sine source

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or V; m/u/µ/μ prefixes, for example 500 mV or 1 V
value_domain.relation: High level must be at least the current low level (factory: 0 V).

limitations: Ideal grounded voltage sources with per-component periodic sine or linear pulse ramps. No output resistance, current limit, battery discharge, noise or physical generator identity. Finite pulse high/low phase lengths include rise/fall respectively. Output sampling can alias; internal integration resolves waveform features within its work budget.
name: Finite pulse source

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or V; m/u/µ/μ prefixes, for example 500 mV or 1 V

limitations: Ideal square source with instantaneous edges and shared experiment phase timing; no output resistance, current limit, noise, ratings or physical part identity.
name: Pulse source

limitations: Generic enhancement PMOS with square-law channel, channel-length modulation and drain-to-source body diode. Body tied to source; zero gate current. No subthreshold conduction, body effect, gate/junction capacitance, charge storage, switching loss, breakdown, heating, ratings or named device identity. External capacitors provide circuit timing. Same illustrative beta magnitude as the generic NMOS, not a physical matched pair.
name: P-channel MOSFET

limitations: Generic enhancement NMOS with square-law channel, channel-length modulation and source-to-drain body diode. Body tied to source; zero gate current. No subthreshold conduction, body effect, gate/junction capacitance, charge storage, switching loss, breakdown, heating, ratings or named device identity. External capacitors provide circuit timing.
name: N-channel MOSFET

limitations: Educational Ebers–Moll DC model; no named physical device, breakdown, Early effect, heating, junction capacitance or switching delay. LED reverse current is neglected. Supports a grounded-emitter switch only.
name: NPN transistor

limitations: Generic five-pin educational macromodel with differential input resistance, midpoint-centered soft voltage limiting, finite output resistance, bounded active output current, supply-dependent enable and explicit supply currents. A declared 1 Gohm output-to-V- bleed remains with power off or reversed; differential input resistance also remains. No internal bandwidth, slew rate, offset/bias mismatch, common-mode restrictions, protection diodes, noise, thermal behavior, ratings or named physical device. External storage supplies circuit timing; this model cannot qualify physical amplifier speed or stability.
name: Powered op-amp

limitations: Common zero-volt reference; this symbol establishes the simulation reference, not protective earth or a physical grounding design.
name: Ground

limitations: Explicit electrical join; geometry/crossings alone do not connect wires. This helper has no physical device model.
name: Junction

limitations: Exact case-sensitive names join attached nets. A name alone never establishes ground. This helper has no physical device model.
name: Net label

value_domain.syntax: Bare SI or Ω/ohm; k/K/M prefixes, for example 2.2k or 0.1M Ω

limitations: Generic linear three-pin resistive track. Total resistance is split into two segments, each with 1 ohm endpoint resistance. Position 0 is toward pin 2; position 1 is toward pin 1. No contact noise, nonlinear taper, ratings, heating or physical part identity.
name: Potentiometer

limitations: Generic silicon junction with Shockley forward/reverse leakage and finite series resistance; no reverse breakdown, capacitance, charge storage, thermal dynamics, ratings or physical part identity.
name: Silicon diode

limitations: Generic SPST with finite on/off resistance; no contact bounce, arcing, thermal behavior, ratings or named physical part. Actuation is instantaneous; capacitor voltage remains continuous.
name: SPST switch
